title: AION 2 Cleric: Skills, Healing and Party Play
description: Understand Cleric healing targets, cleansing, resurrection, damage skills, party buffs and build adjustments for solo, dungeons and PvP.
summary: Learn when to heal, cleanse, resurrect or attack, then select the Stigmas and passives that support that job.
quickAnswer: Cleric uses a mace for magic damage and party recovery. Healing Light heals you and the lowest-HP party member in range; Radiant Recovery heals and removes a debuff. Equip Summon Resurrection separately when your group needs revival.
